title: thoughts about my mallworld dreams
content: I’ve been at the convention center a lot. We always seem to walk in giants circles as we walk around the main area. Lots of shopping and taking pictures like at a baseball game. I see a lot of people I know and don’t know. Sometimes it’s friends, family or my wife. But sometimes it’s a podcast host I’ve watched once, or sometimes it’s my childhood friend that passes my mind once in a blue moon. We all have the same thing in common - it feels like we are on a break, from another life. The other night when I was taking pictures at the convention center, I got a free pin from a shop. I looked at it and it looked just like a pin from a record store here in reality. I mentioned how it looks similar and at the moment there was a connection that was made. One of the rare times I live perfectly in between my two worlds, realities. One night I woke up and the first thing that crossed my mind is “I’m in a video game”. It felt like I entered first person mode, back into my normal body. If you made time to read this, please let me know your thoughts.
